hedgeCoverageRatio.rationale: StandX architecture and product FAQ state policy that USDT/USDC mint deposits are converted to spot assets (ETH/SOL/etc.) with matching short perpetual notionals so spots are 'fully hedged', but the issuer publishes no reconciled spot-vs-short notionals, net delta, or position inventory. Searched: docs architecture/minting/risks/FAQ (narrative only); api.standx.com /reserves, /dusd/reserve, /transparency (HTTP 404); standx.com and standx.com/dusd static HTML (no itemized hedge dashboard); perps.standx.com public endpoints JWT-gated; DefiLlama stablecoin/252 (supply history only, pegMechanism=crypto-backed, no hedge fields); CoinGecko standx-dusd (listing only). Ceffu is not named in official StandX docs reopened at write time. Metric applies to this CEX-perp SDN but is issuer-undisclosed.

marginBufferPct.rationale: Risks docs claim continuous delta monitoring, automatic rebalancing past thresholds, multi-exchange execution, and a 'volatility buffer' / additional collateral in high-vol regimes, but publish no exchange margin balances, maintenance/initial margin, liquidation thresholds, or excess-margin percentage. Searched same surface set as hedgeCoverageRatio (docs, api.standx.com reserve/transparency paths 404, website static HTML, DefiLlama 252, CoinGecko). No measurable protocol-wide excess-backing buffer is disclosed either. Metric applies; value issuer-undisclosed.

lossAbsorptionShare.rationale: Architecture, risks, and product FAQ document a stability/reserve fund that absorbs negative funding weeks and may accumulate when weekly revenue is positive; FAQ says 'please refer to our website for the current reserve ratio' but standx.com static HTML exposes no itemized reserve-fund balance, ratio, or share of liabilities, and api.standx.com has no /reserves or /transparency feed (404). No junior tranche or insurance-fund balance is published. Metric applies; funded first-loss share is issuer-undisclosed.
